name: Playback
storyline:
After receiving an invitation to the grand reopening of Ravenwood Street, the player arrives to find the area abandoned, decaying, and trapped in darkness. While exploring its shops and buildings, they discover hidden documents and mysterious VHS tapes that reveal fragments of what happened to the people who once lived there.
The deeper the player investigates, the more disturbing the story becomes. Missing children, secret experiments, and the name Dr. Zeno begin to connect, while a dangerous entity roams the street and hunts anyone who gets too close to the truth. To escape Ravenwood Street, the player must uncover its secrets, survive the entity, and discover why the cycle keeps repeating.
summary:
PLAYBACK is a first-person psychological horror game set in the abandoned Ravenwood Street. Explore dark buildings, collect mysterious VHS tapes, and uncover hidden documents that reveal the disturbing history of the street and the people who once lived there.
A dangerous entity roams the area, forcing you to stay alert as you investigate locations including Panda’s Bamboo Bar, Wilted Rose, and other forgotten businesses. Every discovery brings you closer to the truth behind missing children, secret experiments, and the mysterious Dr. Zeno.
Search Ravenwood Street, survive the entity, and uncover what was never meant to be found.
